content.text: Head: norm head contour, atraumatic, normocephalic, facial symmetry. ⍉edema, erythema, or masses. ⍉tenderness of scalp, facial structures, joints, and temporal a. on palpation. skull integrity intact. hair texture norm, full even distribution of hair, ⍉masses, facial drooping, fasciculations, thickening of skin, scaling/dryness, bony protuberance. B/L TMJ has ⍉tenderness on palpation, crepitus, or edema. B/L parotid gland = ⍉tender on palpation, firm, or enlrg. B/L sub-mandibular gland = ⍉tender on palpation, firm, or enlrg.

External: BL eyebrow norm size, distribution, shape, extends to outer canthus. BL orbital area has ⍉edema, lesions, masses, redundant skin. BL eyelids are symmetric, have ⍉ptosis, edema, erythema, masses, lesions, scaling, infestations, or fasciculations. BL lacrimal gland unremarkable. Conjunctiva and Sclera pink, ⍉injections, d/c, edema, pterygium, scleral icterus, or FB. Cornea clear. Iris intact. PERRLA, BL 3mm in size. ⍉photo-phobia. EOM intact, ⍉nystagmus. Visual Acuity: Gross visual acuity intact. Using the tumbling E chart, OD, OS, OU: 20/20, ⍉corrective lens used. BL Visual fields are full via confrontation. BL corneal reflex intact. Palpation: ⍉tenderness, masses, lesions, crepitus, edema noted on eyelids, globes, and orbital bones. Fundoscopic exam: BL red reflex. Unremarkable disc-cup ratio. Disc well-defined and cream colored. ⍉haemorrhages, exudates, AV nicking. Macula intact and yellow-free.

External: BL auricle aligned w outer cathus. Auricle, tragus, mastoid, lobule have ⍉tenderness, erythema, edema, masses, or lesions. Internal: BL IAC has mild cerumen. BL IAC has ⍉erythema, edema, d/c, FB, lesions, or masses. BL TM = translucent, pearly, intact, and convex. ⍉effusion, retraction, scarring. BL TM = mobile w bony landmarks and cone of light visualized. Tests: Conversational hearing intact. BL unremarkable finger rub test. Weber lateralize BL. Rinne: AC>BC BL.

External: External inspection norm and symmetric. Skin appropriate color, ⍉masses, lesions, edema, ecchymoses, or rashes. ⍉tenderness of bone, cartilage on palpation. Frontal sinus', maxillary sinus', sphenoid sinus' ⍉tender when palpated and percussed. Transillumination norm. BL nare patency intact. Internal: Muscosa pink, moist and septum mid-line. ⍉d/c, polyps, congestion, or FB.

External: Lips pink, intact, symmetric, well-defines. ⍉edema, lesions, ecchymoses, or crust. Mouth: norm bite. Good dentition, ⍉missing teeth, ⍉tenderness on palpation. Buccal mucosa pink and moist, ⍉lesions. Gingiva pink and firm, ⍉tenderness, lesions, or sores. Tongue = pink and mid-line, ⍉edema or lesions. Parotid glad, submandibular gland, and SL glands are ⍉tender, firm, or enlrg. Pharynx: Pharynx pink, moist, and clear. Soft palate pink and symmetric. Uvula midline w symmetric rise. BL Tonsils +1 w.o exudates. Gag reflex intact.
